recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, high-contrast romantic portrait featuring two figures in an intimate embrace against a textured wall. The scene is bathed in a cool, desaturated blue-grey palette with deep shadows and soft highlights, emphasizing skin texture and fabric folds.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking silhouettes of the two central figures
Contrast between the rough concrete wall and soft skin tones
Vertical alignment of the figures against the vertical wall texture
Cool blue-toned shadows contrasting with neutral highlights
coreInvariants: Intimate, close-up framing of the subjects
Minimalist background to focus on human interaction

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical orientation, figures occupy approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of contact between the two faces in the upper-middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top text, down the line of the figures' bodies, settling on the large title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue-black void on the right side provides balance to the textured wall on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool grey and pale skin tones for highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle desaturated cyan tint across the entire image.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between light skin and dark clothing/background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Generous letter spacing for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal lines extending from the main title to frame the secondary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the main title paired with a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for metadata.

preserve: Extreme letter spacing for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast elegance for the main title.
Offers a clean, modern look for the wide-tracked metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a couple in an intimate embrace against a grey concrete wall. Use cool blue-grey color grading. The man is shirtless or in a simple grey shirt, leaning against the wall. The woman is in a black silk slip dress. Lighting should be dramatic side-lighting with deep shadows on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large centered title in the lower third using a high-contrast serif font in white. Add secondary metadata text at the very top and bottom edges in a small, wide-tracked sans-serif font. Include thin horizontal lines above and below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly cool-toned and desaturated?
Does the main title have high stroke contrast?
Is the secondary text widely spaced?
Is the lighting dramatic and directional?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Amount of letter spacing in metadata

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the background
Check that the blue tint is consistent across the image
Verify the vertical alignment of all centered elements
Confirm the high-contrast serif maintains its fine lines
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate portrait + cool-toned desaturation + high-contrast serif typography + wide-tracked sans-serif metadata.
